units.source: Note Tree
This page explains how to manipulate the note tree in TriliumNext, focusing on moving notes.
Drag and Drop__TRILIUM_PH_0__
You can easily rearrange the note tree by dragging and dropping notes, as demonstrated in the example above.
Importing files__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Tree > Drag and Drop > Importing files

units.source: A file or archive can easily be imported into Trilium just by dragging it inside the note tree.
units.context: Note Tree > Drag and Drop > Importing files

units.source: Note that a drag & drop always imports with __TRILIUM_PH_0__safe import__TRILIUM_PH_1__ on, meaning that some features such as scripts are disabled in the upcoming notes. To bypass that, use the dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_2__import__TRILIUM_PH_3__ feature (right click → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Import into note__TRILIUM_PH_5__).
units.context: Note Tree > Drag and Drop > Importing files

units.source: Unlike the import dialog, the drag & drop also has some basic auto-detection of the import. For example, dragging a .zip file with a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ folder in it will automatically trigger a dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_1__Obsidian__TRILIUM_PH_2__ import.
units.context: Note Tree > Drag and Drop > Importing files

units.source: Keyboard Manipulation__TRILIUM_PH_0__
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Trilium offers efficient keyboard-based manipulation using the following __TRILIUM_PH_1__shortcuts__TRILIUM_PH_2__:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__↑__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__ +__TRILIUM_PH_6__↓__TRILIUM_PH_7__: Move the note up or down in the order.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__←__TRILIUM_PH_3__: Move the note up in the hierarchy by changing its parent to the note's grandparent.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__→__TRILIUM_PH_3__: Move the note down in the hierarchy by setting its parent to the note currently above it (this action is best understood through a demo or hands-on experience).
__TRILIUM_PH_0__←__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__→__TRILIUM_PH_3__: Expand and collapse a sub-tree.
Context Menu__TRILIUM_PH_0__

You can also move notes using the familiar cut and paste functions available in the context menu, or with the associated keyboard __TRILIUM_PH_0__shortcuts__TRILIUM_PH_1__: __TRILIUM_PH_2__ ( __TRILIUM_PH_3__copy__TRILIUM_PH_4__), __TRILIUM_PH_5__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_6__ + __TRILIUM_PH_7__X__TRILIUM_PH_8__ (cut) and __TRILIUM_PH_9__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_10__ + __TRILIUM_PH_11__V__TRILIUM_PH_12__ (paste).
See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note tree contextual menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more information.
Tree Settings__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Click the tree icon in the tree toolbar to open the tree settings popup. Each option takes effect as soon as it is changed:

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Display density__TRILIUM_PH_1__: __TRILIUM_PH_2__Relaxed__TRILIUM_PH_3__ (default) or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Dense__TRILIUM_PH_5__. Dense rows are shorter, so more notes fit on the screen. This setting is not synchronized, so each device keeps its own.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Hide archived notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__: When enabled, archived notes are not shown in the tree.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Automatically collapse notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__: When enabled, notes are collapsed after a period of inactivity to keep the tree tidy.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Follow active note__TRILIUM_PH_1__: When enabled (default), the tree automatically scrolls and expands parent nodes to keep the currently active note visible. When disabled, the tree is fully detached from navigation — only the background highlight of the active note is updated, but the tree viewport and its expanded/collapsed state are never changed by navigation. Use the crosshair button to manually jump the tree to the active note at any time.
Hiding and peeking the tree__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: To hide or show the note tree, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button to the left of the first tab in the horizontal layout, or the __TRILIUM_PH_1__ button at the bottom of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__ in the vertical layout. The __TRILIUM_PH_4__Toggle Left Pane__TRILIUM_PH_5__ __TRILIUM_PH_6__keyboard shortcut__TRILIUM_PH_7__, which is not assigned by default, does the same. See __TRILIUM_PH_8__Vertical and horizontal layout__TRILIUM_PH_9__.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: A small strip with an arrow icon runs along the left edge of the app in the horizontal layout. In the vertical layout, it runs along the right side of the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__, and only shows while the tree is hidden.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: When the tree is hidden, pressing the strip will __TRILIUM_PH_0__peek__TRILIUM_PH_1__ the tree.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: In this mode the tree is shown temporarily above the content, without shifting the content of your notes.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: Clicking outside the tree, pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Esc__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or pressing the strip again will hide the tree.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: Pressing the button that shows the tree will dock it.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: In the horizontal layout, pressing the strip while the tree is docked will hide it.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Peek Tree Pane__TRILIUM_PH_1__ __TRILIUM_PH_2__keyboard shortcut__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__[__TRILIUM_PH_7__ by default, does the same as pressing the strip. Only one panel is peeked at a time: peeking the tree hides a peeked __TRILIUM_PH_8__Right Sidebar__TRILIUM_PH_9__, and the other way around.
units.context: Note Tree > Hiding and peeking the tree
